FN-OQ3YWM-1 RA
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 112
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/24/2023
House Bill 112 as introduced would increase the salary expenses of the Limestone County
Board of Registrars, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated maximum of $24,000
annually. The provisions of this act could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses
reimbursed to the Board from the State General Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
